T: Spice in every dish. Water, carefully.
D: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen of Arrakis to take revenge on those who destroyed his family.
P: Serve the mains when Paul rides his first sandworm.
S: Chickpeas tossed with oil, cumin, smoked paprika, cinnamon and salt, roasted at 200C until crunchy.
bread in the deep desert sietch

Soft yoghurt flatbreads blistered in a dry pan, brushed with butter whipped with Medjool dates, cardamom and flaky salt. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest 15 minutes. Divide into 8 and roll thin. Cook in a very hot dry pan 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Blitz 100g soft butter with 4 pitted Medjool dates, a pinch of ground cardamom and a pinch of salt until smooth. Brush over the hot breads, sprinkle with flaky salt and tear to share.
a sweet bite for the long walk
Medjool dates split and stuffed with a toasted almond and a little goat's cheese, then drizzled with warm honey.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin, coriander, cinnamon and chilli, slow roasted, with golden saffron rice.
the Fremen making every drop of water count

Red lentils simmered thick with onion, garlic, tomato, cumin and turmeric, finished with lemon, a sizzle of chilli butter and fresh coriander. Fry 1 diced onion in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp coriander for 1 minute. Stir in 300g rinsed red lentils, 400g tinned tomatoes and 1L vegetable stock and simmer 25 minutes, stirring, until thick. Add the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Melt 40g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes and cumin seeds until sizzling, pour over and top with coriander. Serve with flatbread.
W: spice must flow, even into dessert
Cardamom, cinnamon and ginger cake baked with honey until dark and moist, glazed while warm and cut into thick slices.
K: Cardamom spice coffee with date syrup
the spice coffee shared in the sietch

Strong coffee brewed with crushed cardamom, cinnamon and a pinch of clove, sweetened with date syrup and topped with frothed milk. Lightly crush 8 cardamom pods. Put them in a saucepan with 600ml water, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 cloves and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 6 tbsp finely ground coffee, take off the heat and steep 4 minutes, then strain through a fine sieve or plunger. Stir in 3 tbsp date syrup. Froth 200ml hot milk and spoon over 4 small cups of the coffee, with a pinch of cinnamon on top.

s.how: Drain and dry 800g chickpeas well. Toss with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and salt. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, shaking twice, until crunchy. Cool 5 minutes before serving.

s.note: a sweet bite for the long walk
s.how: Split 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a little goat's cheese (100g total) and a toasted almond. Lay on a plate and drizzle with 2 tbsp warm honey just before serving.

m.how: Rub a 1.5kg lamb shoulder with 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp cinnamon, chilli and salt. Roast covered at 160C for 3.5 hours until it pulls apart. Steep a pinch of saffron in hot water and cook 300g basmati rice with it until golden and fluffy.

w.note: spice must flow, even into dessert
w.how: Melt 150g butter with 150g honey and 100g brown sugar. Mix with 250g self-raising flour, 2 tsp cardamom, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger, 2 eggs and 125ml milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes and brush with warm honey.
